column3: The blessed person is described distributively in the singular: everyone who fears.
The produce is explicitly that of your hands.
There are no separate words for flourishing or sitting. The wife is within the inner parts of the house.
The man is passively blessed rather than a blessing being the grammatical subject that comes.
After the blessing, see is an imperative rather than a purpose clause.
See is again an imperative; sons of your sons are specifically named.
